general_info: This is a dataset collects HVAC relevant data of NAE-01 in the University of California San Diego,consisting of 4 floors and 80 rooms. The dataset contains 3 types of data of each room: Zone temperature, Real power mean, and Real energy into the load interval. The data is collected every 5 minutes.
downtime_prompt: The sensor is down for unknown reasons, readings set to 0.
